column1: # action-row-0x2C-bit-readers - every provenance-verified read of the action row's +0x2C byte / word (the 40 sites of members/action-row-reader-hops.tsv at offset 0x2C), with the literal mask or compare the site applies, or the register form it uses instead (UQ-107, FABLE, 2026-09-18).

# A literal `mask` names the bit(s) tested; `(no immediate)` sites test the word against a register mask (`test word [row+0x2C], ax`, built by the status-mask family) or use the byte as a value. No site tests 0x20 (bit 5) literally.
